evidence.note: A two-night pay-per-view opening the federation's 1999 record in the held record, crowning a new AWMC Champion in a Hell in a Cell main event.

matches.note: "Mr. Extreme" Shane Riggins defeated "The Dark Saint" Jim Shaw.
Alexzander Dubois defeated Sean Slade.
Axel Schmidt defeated "Cunning" Chris James.

Barbwire match: "Mr. Excitement" Alex Extreme defeated Twizted after Fang ran in with a chair; a masked interloper then revealed himself as "Superstar" Tyrone Parker and tombstoned Extreme through a stack of tables.
Joey "IQ" Johnson defeated Carl Stevenson, with Paul Styles as guest referee.
Fang and X defeated Cobra and Viper.
AWMC Iron Man Title: "The Blade" Justin Cruise (champion) defeated Richard Anderson.
Octagon Match: Kuwasi "Blackfist" Shakur defeated "Outcast" Rob Cole, with Retribution returning to the federation to help turn the match Shakur's way.
"Rolemodel" Paul Styles defeated Justin B.
Three-way match: Tuulenux defeated Ron Van Clam and "The Wolverine" Johnny Rotten.
Eddie Chavez defeated Shatterstar.
J.C. $ilk defeated Trey Lawrenze.
Eclipse defeated Outlaw.
The HeadHunter defeated X.
AWMC Extremist Title: Craig Miller defeated Chris Gotham to regain the belt, the federation revealing that Miller had been wrestling under a mask as "Sanchez" during Gotham's reign.
AWMC Tag Team Titles, Bat on a Pole match: Crazed Animals defeated Urban Legend with an assist from Death Row.
Sean Eden and Brian Black defeated "Studmuffin" Kris Stone and "Revolutionary" Matt Reid.
Main event, AWMC Championship, Hell in a Cell: Kuwasi "Blackfist" Shakur defeated "Rolemodel" Paul Styles for the vacant title, with a returning Retribution again turning the match in Shakur's favor.
